Apple today ushered in a new CEO. At the same time, a rare 1996 footage of Steve Jobs resurfaced, offering viewers highly inspirational insights.

The interview came from Maryland Public Television's programme *Wall Street Week*, hosted by Louis Rukeyser.

Conducted before Jobs returned to Apple, the interview featured a memorable remark in which he spoke of his belief that Apple could turn its fortunes around through innovation.

"I don't think the way out is to dramatically cut costs. Apple rose to greatness through innovation, and I believe Apple can return to greatness through innovation as well."

Thirty years on, his words have proven correct (for Apple, for Pixar, and for *Toy Story* alike).
